question: Theme of World Environment Day 2022 is _________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only One Earth**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• World Environment Day:

 
 
• It is celebrated every year on the5th of June. It was established in 1972 by the United Nations at the Stockholm Conference on the Human Environment
 
• It was first celebrated in the year1974.
 
• The theme for world environment day 2022 is *Only One Earth*.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• United Nations:

 
 
• The UNO was formed on 24 October 1945.
 
• At present, 193 countries are members of the UN.
 
• South Sudan is the latest and the 193rd member to join the UN in 2011
 
• The UN Charter came into force on October 24, 1945, when the Governments of China, France, the UK, the Soviet Union, the USA and a majority of other counties had ratified it.
 
• The headquarters of the UN is situated in New York (USA).
